title: Numba JIT phi-node cycle deadlocking type inference compiler pass
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0323: Numba JIT phi-node cycle deadlocking type inference compiler pass
Repository: `numba/numba`
Category: `Compiler IR Optimization & SSA Lowering`
Target File: `numba/core/typeinfer.py`

#### Problem Description
Mutually recursive loop variables cause unconstrained unification cycle in Hindley-Milner type solver.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Introduce unification depth limit and break phi cycles by inserting intermediate union types.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0323.py -q`
expected_invariant: Introduce unification depth limit and break phi cycles by inserting intermediate union types.
